# --instructions--

Declare an enum class `Direction` with the entries `NORTH`, `EAST`, `SOUTH` and `WEST`, in this order. Then write a function `turnRight(direction: Direction)` that returns the entry that follows `direction`, wrapping around from `WEST` back to `NORTH`.

Hint: combine `ordinal`, `entries` and the `%` operator.

# --solutions--

```kotlin
enum class Direction {
    NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, WEST
}

fun turnRight(direction: Direction): Direction {
    val next = (direction.ordinal + 1) % Direction.entries.size
    return Direction.entries[next]
}
```
